name: lantern
description: A guiding light for when you go dark. Automatically passes your chosen secrets to family members, inside 1Password.

variables.name: Service Account Token
variables.description: 1Password service account token with allow creation of new vaults permission only.

variables.name: Run Token
variables.description: Shared secret. Any long random string. You must send this token when calling POST /run.

variables.name: Vault Title
variables.description: Name of vaults Lantern will create.

variables.name: Inactive After Days
variables.description: Days without a 1Password login before a user's vault is shared. Warnings for the last 3 days. Valid values: 7-365.

variables.name: Test Day
variables.description: Test the system without waiting. It pretends every member has been idle that many days. Put a dummy item in your Lantern vault. 87 is a warning (3 days left). 90 shares anyone who has items. Leave it empty when you are done.

variables.name: Ping URL
variables.description: Get notified if the container stops running by setting PING_URL to an external service like healthchecks.io. A successful run pings the URL. Leave empty to skip.

variables.name: Auto Run
variables.description: Automatically call run on start and every 24 hours. Set `false` if you only use a scheduler like n8n. No notifications unless something externally calls POST /run.
